correctness.rationale: For w in (0,pi/2], n odd≥3, the spherical cosine rule yields sin(rho)=sin(w/2)/cos(pi/(2n)), short arc aperture alpha_n=2 asin(sin(pi/(2n))/cos(w/2)), and Gauss–Bonnet gives area 2pi−n alpha_n(1+cos w), perimeter n alpha_n sin w. Setting h(t)=asin(sin t/c), t=pi/(2n), h′′(t)>0 and h′′′ increasing on 0<t≤pi/6, c² in [1/2,1), makes h(t)/t and [h(t)−t/c]/t³ increasing. Therefore area increases, perimeter decreases, normalized n² deficit decreases strictly to pi³ sin²(w/2)/(12c); n=3 upper sharp and n→∞ lower sharp. Width pi/2 endpoint matches published spherical formula. Direct independent high-precision evaluation for four widths and eight odd n per width confirmed all bounds. The analytic derivative and Gauss–Bonnet steps, not finite tests, establish the theorem.
